pr_title: fix: Fix incorrect top-k by sorted column, fix `head()` returning extra rows
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20719
* https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20719

Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20712
* https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20712

Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20715
* https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/20715

##### Changelog
* Removes a `descending` parameter from `SortOptions.limit` - it is duplicated with the top-level `descending` config
* Fixes an issue where `top_k` on sorted data containing duplicates returned incorrect values (the duplicated rows were ignored):

```python
pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 2]}).sort("a", descending=True).top_k(2, by="a")
# Before
shape: (2, 1)
┌─────┐
│ a   │
│ --- │
│ i64 │
╞═════╡
│ 2   │
│ 1   │
└─────┘
# After
shape: (2, 1)
┌─────┐
│ a   │
│ --- │
│ i64 │
╞═════╡
│ 2   │
│ 2   │
└─────┘
```

issue_context.title: ComputeError: input data is not sorted in group_by_dynamic
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
df = pl.select(
    time=pl.datetime_range(
        pd.Timestamp("20250113 00:01:00.000000"),
        pd.Timestamp("20250117 00:00:00.000000"),
        interval="1m",
    )
    .cast(pl.String)
    .reverse(),
    val=pl.Series(range(5760)),
    cat=pl.Series(list(range(16)) * 360),
)

df.lazy().with_columns(
    pl.col("time").str.to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.f", strict=False).alias("time2")
).sort("time2").group_by_dynamic("time2", every="1m", group_by=["cat"]).agg(
    pl.sum("val")
).sort(
    "time2"
).collect()

# ComputeError: input data is not sorted
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

If I use lazyframe and call `.sort` after `.group_by_dynamic`, I'll get a `ComputeError: input data is not sorted` error. Dropping the `sort` after the `.group_by_dynamic` works.

### Expected behavior

It should return the group_by_dynamic result instead of raising an error. I confirmed that in `1.11.0`, it returns the correct output.

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:              1.19.0
Index type:          UInt32
```

</details>

review_comments: Issue was this `desc` parameter, I've removed it
